content.short: Gate is a long-running global exchange holding reserves across Hyperliquid, Monad and other chains.
content.description: Gate, previously Gate.io, is one of the older centralised exchanges still operating, with a catalogue that runs far deeper into small-cap listings than most of its peers. Its on-chain reserves are among the larger balances held on both Hyperliquid and Monad, which is how a centralised venue ends up ranked alongside protocols in chain TVL tables. For a new chain, an exchange holding meaningful reserves matters mainly because it signals deposits and withdrawals are supported in production.
content.meta: One of the longest-running global exchanges, with sizeable onchain reserves on Hyperliquid and Monad.
